named_events.loss_description: The current ultimate best estimate financial impact of COVID-19 is GBP 21.7m, net of reinsurance and including reinstatement premiums, primarily in its Accident and Health, Personal Accident Treaty and Credit Risk lines of business.

named_events.event_name: FCA business interruption test case (UK Supreme Court judgement)
named_events.loss_description: In light of the UK Supreme Court ruling, the Syndicate has performed a detailed review of the business interruption clauses in its insurance and reinsurance contracts and concluded that there is no material impact on the COVID-19 best estimate loss booked for the year ended 31 December 2020.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding opening balance at 1 January 2020 was GBP 372.186m. During 2020 there was a small prior-year release in gross claims provisions of GBP 5.299m (a 1.4% release of opening reserves), recorded in the technical provisions movement. The release reflects predominantly favourable claims development and an increase in reinsurance recoverables; COVID-19 is separately quantified as a gross GBP 71.6m impact (GBP 21.7m net). No specific prior underwriting-year catastrophe events are identified as driving the prior-year reserve movement in the gross movement note.
raw_causal_phrases: The current ultimate best estimate financial impact of COVID-19 is GBP 21.7m, net of reinsurance and including reinstatement premiums.

Adverse movements of GBP 1.0 thousand (2019: GBP 18.5 million adverse) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) taken from Note 16 'Technical provisions' movement row 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross column). No gross PYD by individual LOB is provided in the gross movement note; some other notes present net movements. The claims development triangle (gross) is available and was not used as the primary PYD source because an explicit gross prior-year movement figure was available. Lob-level PYD amounts are not available on a gross basis in the movement note and therefore lob_movements are empty.
